scope: Named generative models and closely related speech, retrieval and moderation models in official provider catalogs. Dated snapshots, quantizations and aliases are grouped. Provider access and regional availability vary.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.note: Named models across the API and open-weight catalog, including still-available older versions. Retirement dates are shown; dated snapshots and equivalent routing aliases are grouped.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.note: Public Claude models plus restricted Mythos releases. Older models remain listed while supported; Sonnet 4.5 is scheduled to retire November 30, 2026. The featured flagship is the most capable generally available Claude; Mythos requires trusted access.

companies.name: Google
companies.note: Gemini API model catalog, including media, speech, and search models. Gemini 2.5 access is limited to existing users. Preview availability may change.

companies.name: Meta
companies.note: Muse is delivered through Meta products. Llama weights are downloadable for developers under Meta licenses; model sizes and variants are grouped by release.

companies.name: xAI
companies.note: Grok models across text, media and voice. Grok 4.7 Fast is a delivery mode in selected products, not a separate model. Retired model aliases are excluded.

history.summary: Initial source-linked model catalog and AI Landscape dashboard.
